spans.s: (I)--Kings ten in number, commencing with पुष्यमित्र: Ruled the earth for more than hundred years (११२ years, वा। प्।). (३०० years according to म्। प्।), in the म्। प्। eight of them are mentioned, प्रुष्यमित्र, वसुज्येष्ठ, Vasumitra, Antaka, Pulindaka, Vajramitra, समाभाग, and देवभूमि; ruled after the Mauryas. भा.
